name: Kagayama Natsuki
source:
A 2nd year high school student. She is the granddaughter of the village chief. She's a curious tomboy who has never been out of town due to her family, and has a great admiration for the outside world. For better or for worse, she is honest and can make sharp statements.

[Translated from [url=https://ahonojuge00.wixsite.com/rinjou-stargazer]official website[/url]]
